description: Synthetic RED/GREEN evals for cron payload stale-state discipline. Baseline captures prompt-state parroting. With-skill behavior must reject or rewrite payloads so step 1 is a live `!` query with frame metadata.

evals.name: hardcoded-review-state-parrot
evals.description: A cron payload hardcodes BLOCKED REVIEW_REQUIRED and asks the agent to monitor. This is the smoking-gun failure mode from BRIEF 4.
evals.prompt:
Review this cron payload for orc:

Tick frame:
- now: 2026-05-02T17:10:00Z
- cycle: 14
- last-action-timestamp: 2026-05-02T16:42:00Z

We have 3 PRs at merge gate BLOCKED REVIEW_REQUIRED. Keep monitoring and stay SILENT unless one unblocks.
1. Read the state above.
2. Check the collab file.
3. If still blocked, say SILENT autonomous.

Should this payload ship as-is?

assertions.name: rejects-hardcoded-review-state
assertions.description: Does not accept BLOCKED REVIEW_REQUIRED as ground truth

assertions.name: rewrites-step-1-to-live-query
assertions.description: Replaces the stale claim with a live `!gh pr view` or `!gh pr list` query in step 1

assertions.name: explains-prompt-state-vs-live-state
assertions.description: States that decision logic must follow rendered query output rather than prompt prose

assertions.name: preserves-frame-discipline
assertions.description: Keeps or adds now/cycle/last-action-timestamp in the corrected frame

evals.name: no-live-query-in-step-1
evals.description: Payload has a live query, but only after several stale setup lines.
evals.prompt:
Review this cron payload:

Tick frame:
- now: $(date -Iseconds)
- cycle: 8
- last-action-timestamp: 2026-05-02T17:00:00Z

1. Summarize the current blocked PRs from memory.
2. Mention that PR #189 is still REVIEW_REQUIRED.
3. Explain that this is probably unchanged.
4. !gh pr view EtanHey/golems 189 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision
5. Decide whether to ping the worker.

Should this payload ship as-is?

assertions.name: does-not-allow-explanatory-step-1
assertions.description: Flags that step 1 cannot be memory or narration

assertions.name: moves-live-query-to-step-1
assertions.description: Rewrites the payload so the live query is the first operation

assertions.name: removes-hardcoded-review-claim
assertions.description: Eliminates the REVIEW_REQUIRED claim from the prompt body

assertions.name: keeps-decision-tree-after-query
assertions.description: Places branching logic after the live data is rendered

evals.name: missing-frame-discipline
evals.description: Payload queries live data but omits enough frame metadata to detect stale ticks.
evals.prompt:
Review this cron payload:

1. !find $ORCHESTRATOR_REPO/collab -newer 2026-05-02T16:58:00Z
2. If there are new files, read them.
3. Otherwise say SILENT.

Should this payload ship as-is?

assertions.name: does-not-accept-metadata-free-frame
assertions.description: Flags that the payload is missing rendered current time, cycle counter, and last-action-timestamp

assertions.name: adds-now-cycle-last-action
assertions.description: Adds all three frame-discipline fields to the payload

assertions.name: keeps-live-query
assertions.description: Retains the live query rather than replacing it with prose

assertions.name: explains-why-staleness-would-be-undetectable
assertions.description: Explains why repeated identical frames cannot be trusted without frame metadata

evals.name: long-payload-hidden-staleness
evals.description: Payload is long enough to hide stale assumptions and only reaches live data late in the sequence.
evals.prompt: Review this 34-line monitor payload. Lines 1-28 narrate that two workers are blocked, the merge queue is frozen, and no files changed. Line 29 says `!list_surfaces`. Line 30 says `!find $ORCHESTRATOR_REPO/collab -newer 2026-05-02T16:58:00Z`. Lines 31-34 say to stay SILENT if nothing changed. Should this payload ship as-is?

assertions.name: flags-over-30-lines-without-live-query-step-1
assertions.description: Treats the payload as a violation because the first live query appears too late

assertions.name: collapses-stale-narration
assertions.description: Removes or condenses stale setup lines that state queue status as fact

assertions.name: restarts-payload-with-live-query
assertions.description: Rewrites the payload so a `!` query is the first step

assertions.name: maintains-decision-tree-after-data
assertions.description: Keeps the later branching logic but only after live data is rendered

evals.name: accepts-compliant-payload
evals.description: A payload already follows the discipline and should be accepted rather than over-rewritten.
evals.prompt:
Review this cron payload:

Tick frame:
- now: $(date -Iseconds)
- cycle: 11
- last-action-timestamp: 2026-05-02T17:05:00Z

1. !gh pr view EtanHey/golems 189 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision
2. If mergeStateStatus is REVIEW_REQUIRED, ping the assigned worker once.
3. If mergeable is MERGEABLE, dispatch merge.
4. Otherwise stay SILENT.

Should this payload ship as-is?

assertions.name: recognizes-compliant-step-1
assertions.description: Accepts the live-query-first structure

assertions.name: recognizes-valid-frame-discipline
assertions.description: Accepts now/cycle/last-action-timestamp as sufficient frame metadata

assertions.name: does-not-invent-staleness-problem
assertions.description: Does not rewrite a compliant payload into something unrelated

assertions.name: connects-decision-tree-to-live-output
assertions.description: Acknowledges that the branching logic correctly consumes live query results

evals.name: drive-to-completion-monitor-tick
evals.description: Monitor ticks must query live state, preserve counters, and end in dispatch, verify-and-decrement, or escalate-park.
evals.prompt: Review this monitor loop behavior. Tick 1 through tick 12 all contain the same body: 'PR #393 is BLOCKED REVIEW_REQUIRED. Keep monitoring and stay silent unless it unblocks.' The tick does not run `!gh pr view` or any other live query. Should this loop continue as-is?

assertions.name: does-not-accept-hardcoded-review-loop
assertions.description: Rejects repeated hardcoded review state as invalid monitor input

assertions.name: requires-live-query-step-1
assertions.description: Rewrites the tick so step 1 is a `!gh pr view` or equivalent live query

assertions.name: forces-one-of-three-outcomes
assertions.description: Requires dispatch, verify-and-decrement, or escalate-park instead of passive monitoring

assertions.name: resets-only-after-verified-decrement
assertions.description: States counters reset only after a merge, task completion, or expected artifact write is verified

evals.name: parsed-only-freeze-rotation
evals.description: Freeze checks must rotate exactly one full read onto the worst offender and require prompt proof before declaring idle.
evals.prompt: There are 5 cmux surfaces. For ticks 1 through 3, the monitor reads every surface with `parsed_only=true` and gets the same wrapper each time. It performs 15 parsed reads total, zero full-screen reads, and concludes that surface s:7 is idle. Should this behavior ship as-is?

assertions.name: rejects-parsed-only-idle-verdict
assertions.description: Does not accept an idle conclusion drawn from repeated parsed-only wrappers alone

assertions.name: forces-one-full-read-on-worst-offender
assertions.description: Escalates exactly one worst-offender surface to a full read instead of all suspicious surfaces

assertions.name: requires-bottom-prompt-plus-sixty-seconds
assertions.description: Requires bottom-of-screen prompt proof plus 60 seconds of identical full-screen reads before idle

assertions.name: parks-long-running-ops
assertions.description: Parks the monitor branch, not the worker, around known long-running builds/tests/deploys
